Educational estimates only — not financial advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the loan amount, base rate and the points you are considering.
  2. Enter the rate reduction each point buys and how many years you will stay.
  3. Read the break-even month and your net savings.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a discount point?

One discount point costs 1% of the loan amount, paid up front at closing, in exchange for a lower interest rate.

How is break-even calculated?

Break-even months = (points cost) ÷ (monthly payment savings). After that month, the lower payment puts you ahead.

When are points NOT worth it?

If your break-even month comes after you plan to sell or refinance, points usually do not pay off. They work best for long stays.
